correctness.rationale: The finite-dimensional non-Hermitian generator has purely surviving modes precisely in the Hermitian adjacency eigenspaces with zero hub amplitude; the invariant complement is strictly dissipative. Each open Dirichlet path arm has sine eigenmodes at 2J cos(πk/L_i). Equal energies mean equal reduced fractions a/b; each b divides exactly m_b arm lengths, and the hub junction constraint removes a single weighted coefficient direction. Consequently multiplicity per primitive fraction is (m_b−1)_+, giving the totient sum, gcd criterion and rank-one-complement projector with diagonal sine² sitewise survival. The source verify_arithmetic.py derives exact integer Krylov ranks, and verify_projector.py reconstructs eigenspace projectors for 145 graphs; an independent new exact Krylov check on augmented lengths (2,3,5), (2,3,6), (2,2,2) yielded dark dimensions 0,3,2, respectively. Finite numerics are corroboration only; the all-length theorem is analytic.
